title: Cyclic Sieving Phenomenon for Independent sets of graphs
summary: In this paper, we present examples of the cyclic sieving phenomenon coming from studying independent sets in graphs of a fixed size k. Given a graph G, and a cyclic group C acting on the graph, then C also acts on the collection of independent sets of G of a fixed size k. We exhibit cyclic sieving phenomena for a cyclic group acting on the collection of independent sets of powers of cycle graphs. As a corollary, we also find a closed formula for the number of independent sets of a given size in the power of a cycle graph, and in the power of a path.
